{"metadata":{"description":"Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications, and secure remote access.","id":"gh:1344979342","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-deeppilot","slug":"Mars-Sea/dsh-deeppilot","topics":["deeppilot","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","ios","mobile","notifications","remote-access","tailscale"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications,"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" and secure remote access."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deeppilot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The open-source DSH companion plugin for **DeepPilot**, a native iPhone client
for using DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rness remotely. It connects the app directly to the DSH
Host on your own computer and does not repla"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ce or modify the DSH Web UI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> DeepPilot is currently in TestFlight review. The invitation link will accept
> testers after Apple"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" approves the build."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Join the DeepPilot TestFlight"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Browse projects, sessions, history, and live agent output from iPhone.
- Stream assistant text and"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" reasoning while viewing a session; reconnects recover
the durable history rather than treating part"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ial output as a completed answer.
- Export a full ZIP log archive, or share the conversation body as"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" Markdown when
the Host provides that optional route.
- Check plugin updates from the app and instal"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"l an explicitly confirmed compatible
version. The Host handles hot replacement and rollback; without"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" hot reload the
app reports that a DSH restart is required.
- Send prompts, switch models, create se"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ssions, and answer approvals/questions.
- Pair with a five-minute single-use code and a per-device P"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"-256 key; physical
iPhones keep the private key in Secure Enclave.
- Connect over the LAN (TLS with "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"a Host-issued certificate pinned during
pairing) or the optional embedded Tailscale Funnel.
- Receiv"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"e live notifications and optional APNs notifications while offline.
- Local web preview: open a `htt"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"p://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`
link from the conversation (a design canvas or dev serve"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"r the agent started)
inside the app, with its live reload intact.
- Quiet scheduled runs (DSH 0.2.2+"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"): write a rule into a scheduled task's
prompt, such as "if everything is normal, don't notify me". "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"The agent can
then skip that run's "task completed" notification with the
`deeppilot_skip_completion"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"_notice` tool. Approvals, questions and errors
still notify, and tasks without such a rule notify on"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" every run as before.
- Self-update hint: the settings page footer shows the installed plugin
versio"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"n, with an inline "new version" link to the matching GitHub
release when one exists (background chec"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"k, stable releases only, no
third-party dependency)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install from npm"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This source checkout targets Node.js 22+ and DSH hosts inside the rolling
compatibility range `>=0.2"},{"id":"p10s2","text":".1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0` with a `web` profile. The lower
bound is the newest audited `rc` release at decisi"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"on time — npm `latest` and
`next` both point at `0.2.1-rc.5` — and every later `0.2.x` release is ad"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"mitted
automatically, including the `alpha` channel release `0.2.2-alpha.2` and later
alphas, later "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"rc releases, and `0.2.x` GA. `0.3.0` and its prereleases stay
refused until a fresh audit. DSH check"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s a plugin's declared requirements before
composing a profile, on every start rather than only on in"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"stall, so a host
outside the range refuses to activate this plugin. From DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4` on,
tha"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"t check reads `engines.dsh` and ignores `peerDependencies`; older hosts know
only the peer range, so"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" both declare the identical range. The package includes
Funnel helpers for macOS, Linux, and Windows"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" on amd64/arm64; trusted-LAN mode
does not require the helper. The helper is built with Go 1.27, whi"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ch requires
**macOS 13 Ventura or later**: on macOS 12 and earlier, Funnel mode cannot
start, while "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"trusted-LAN mode keeps working."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The current working tree declares that range in `engines.dsh` and
`peerDependencies` and is built/ty"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"pechecked against `0.2.1-rc.5`. A previously
published plugin package may still carry its own older "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"compatibility
declaration until a release is made from this tree."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After DSH restarts, open **Settings → DeepPilot**, turn on **Allow phone connections**,
and click **"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"Add phone** beside **Paired devices**, then scan the QR code in the app. The same panel also shows o"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ne copyable piece of pairing info (address, single-use code and
certificate fingerprint) that can be"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" pasted into the app in one step — useful for
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Connection and privacy"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Conversation traffic travels directly between the iPhone and your DSH Host and
is always encrypted: "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"the LAN listener on port `3098` serves TLS with a
self-signed certificate whose fingerprint the app "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"receives during pairing, and
Funnel mode uses Tailscale-issued certificates. The app refuses plain `"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ws://`.
Both the LAN listener and optional Funnel mode expose only the DeepPilot
connection, one-tim"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"e pairing, and health endpoints, not the complete DSH Web UI."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Local web preview forwards raw bytes over a separate authenticated connection
to a loopback port on "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"this computer. A port is reachable only after it has
appeared in that session's messages; the plugin"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"'s own ports and the DSH Web
default port `3080` are always refused, and only `http` loopback links "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"with an
explicit port qualify. The settings page's **Local web preview** switch (on by
default) turn"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"s it off for every paired phone; open streams close at once."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The DeepPilot settings page exposes **Connections per public source**. It
defaults to `8`, accepts `"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"1`–`16`, and briefly restarts the Funnel helper when
changed, so connected remote clients reconnect "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"once (its exact section may
move between DSH versions; go by the settings page's current layout). Th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e
device list also supports a custom name for each paired device. Names are
stored in the host regis"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"try and survive iPhone reconnects or changes to the
system-reported name; saving an empty value rest"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ores the iPhone-reported
default."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Each device's **More actions** control contains its fingerprint, rename action,
and deletion action;"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" deletion still requires confirmation. Connection options,
connection help, diagnostic tools, and sy"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"stem information start collapsed.
Desktop secondary buttons are 28px high; custom action touch targe"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ts remain at
least 44px. **Add phone** uses DSH's built-in small outlined `Button`; all
toggles use "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"its `Switch`. Native controls keep the host's appearance and sizing.
See settings UI and validation."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The settings page's **Diagnostic tools** group has a `debug` toggle.
Turning it on prints per-frame "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"and push diagnostics to the DSH host's terminal
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"See COMPATIBILITY.md for the tested baseline and current
limitations. DSH is still evolving; include"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" exact DSH and plugin versions when
reporting an issue."}],"truncated":true}
